source_text: Fecerunt malignum; traditi in manus Chusarsathaim regis Mesopotamiae — princeps aërius. Peccatum tradit sub potestates.
pass_a_gloss: They-did evil; handed into hands of-Cushan-rishathaim king of-Mesopotamia — prince aerial. Sin hands-over under powers.
pass_b_english: [[They did evil and were sold into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim >> Bible:Judges 3:8]] — an aerial prince. Sin hands us over under the powers.
